Contract CoCoMEOrderProducts::orderItem(barcode: Integer,quantity: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		orderEntry: OrderEntry = OrderEntry.allInstance()->any(o|o.Item.Barcode = barcode),
		item: Item = Item.allInstance()->any(i|i.Barcode = barcode)
	precondition:
		item.oclIsUndefined() = bool
	postcondition:
		let orderEntry: OrderEntry in
		orderEntry.oclIsNew() and
		orderEntry.Quantity = quantity and
		orderEntry.SubAmount = item.Price*quantity and
		orderEntry.Item = item and
		CurrentOrderProduct.ContainedEntries->includes(orderEntry)
}
